name: Plausibility
rule: Impossible or placeholder values (for example 999, BP 1/1) are emptied before any rule reads them

name: Only fired triggers
rule: Only fired triggers become needs; cannot-tell becomes a question

name: Red flags
rule: A RED alert stops the script and escalates the same day

name: Gates
rule: Exclusion = 1 in the extract and declined consent remove a member from every campaign

name: Consent
rule: Nothing below the consent card is rendered until consent is logged

name: Contact cap
rule: No new outreach call within 14 days of a reached call; max 3 attempts

name: Declines held
rule: A declined need is not re-offered for 90 days

name: A deadline wins
rule: A due date inside the contact cap still gets a call

name: Prerequisites
rule: An action waiting on another is released when it closes

name: Ask once
rule: A cannot-tell question is asked once

name: Dispositions survive a re-run
rule: Done and declined needs are never reopened by the same extract

name: Staff work
rule: Work is assigned by language, then skill, within daily capacity
